name: Ajuricaba (Brazil)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white over light blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Ajuricaba is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 10 May 1978 (prescribed with the arms by Law No. 237 of 10 May 1978, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a four-towered mural crown, a cauldron, a tractor and wheat, over a scroll reading 29-05 AJURICABA-RS 1966
